title: Saul on the road to Damascus blinded by an orb
plain: The bright light that blinded Saul on the road to Damascus, in the Bible's Book of Acts, was really an orb, a glowing ball of light. Chris Bledsoe, a man who says UFOs are drawn to him and whom NASA has studied, says so as his own reading of the passage, with no other source. If he is right, one of the best-known conversions in Christian scripture would be an early sighting of the same lights he says he sees.
